result.title: Deploying a Control-Logic LLM Assistant in Air-Gapped Power Plants: Lessons in Source Authority and Bounded Retrieval
result.comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at IAAI-27 (AAAI 2027). 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
result.summary: Deploying Large Language Model (LLM) assistants in industrial operational technology environments poses constraints largely absent from cloud applications: site policies restrict engineering and operational data from leaving the plant, on-premises compute is limited, and incorrect causal attribution can mislead incident response. We report lessons from deploying a control-logic evidence layer that underpins a broader on-premises operator assistance system at two gas power plants. Two prototypes revealed where generative models added avoidable uncertainty and cost. The first used a Vision Language Model (VLM) to reconstruct control topology from PDF printouts routinely exchanged by engineers. Across the full 6,979-page document, extraction reached 0.51 connection precision and required 3.1 hours on 4xH200 GPUs; consultation with controls engineers then revealed a native structured export from the authoring system. The second used an LLM tool-calling agent to plan repeatedly over eight predefined graph operations. In a controlled benchmark of 40 template-generated questions, replacing this agent with explicit execution plans reduced mean token use by 20x and median latency by 3x, with identical retrieved node sets across repeated runs. The deployed design ingests the authoritative export into a versioned knowledge graph, executes bounded graph operations in fixed software, and confines the local LLM to fallback intent classification and evidence-grounded explanation. At one site, the graph contains 221K nodes across seven controllers. Our experience suggests a practical division of labor for high-consequence AI: LLMs interpret natural-language requests and explain results, while deterministic software constructs and retrieves technical evidence grounded in authoritative sources. Abstention, entity disambiguation, graph versioning, and read-only integration provide additional safeguards.

AI.brief_summary: 报告在两座燃气电厂内网部署控制逻辑助手的两轮原型经验：先用 VLM 从 6,979 页 PDF 图纸重建控制拓扑，连接精度仅 0.51 且耗时 3.1 小时；后用 LLM 工具调用智能体在八个图操作上反复规划，改为固定执行计划后 token 降 20 倍、延迟降 3 倍且检索节点集稳定。最终设计以版本化知识图谱和确定性软件取证为主，LLM 仅承担意图分类与基于证据的解释。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「生成模型负责解释、确定性软件负责构造与检索证据」的分工，以及弃权、实体消歧、有界检索与成本核算，可为本研究中视觉证据筛选、证据获取与停止决策的收益/成本权衡提供概念参照，VLM 读图低精度也提示视觉细节抽取需外部核查。
